lemma income (m:ℕ): Arrives (fun i=> drawerE S i m n (rose S n w m i)) := by
    refine Camp.trim ?_; intro ε h
    have he (v:ℕ):= mist S n H w hp ht hw hC m (m+v) (Nat.le_add_right ..)
    obtain ⟨k,hk⟩:= ((tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num [Camp.soft,Oriel.rim]:0≤ Camp.soft) (by norm_num [Camp.soft,Oriel.rim])).eventually_le_const h).exists
    exact ⟨_, (he k).1,(eventually_ge_atTop (m+k)).mono fun i hi=> by rw [dist_comm,dist_eq_norm]; exact ((he k).2 _ hi|>.2.trans (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hk))⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The level-m outputs `drawerE (rose ..)` converge: for every ε choose k with `soft^k ≤ ε`, so they are within ε eventually of the convergent truncation `cup` from `mist`.

lemma trim {Z: Type*} [MetricSpace Z][CompleteSpace Z] {f:ℕ→ Z}(he:∀ ε:ℝ,0<ε →∃ g:ℕ→Z, Arrives g ∧ ∀ᶠ i in atTop, dist (f i) (g i)≤ ε): Arrives f:=by
   apply cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete; rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
   intro ε h; obtain ⟨g,⟨y,hg⟩,hx⟩:= he (ε/4) (by positivity)
   obtain ⟨i,hi⟩:= eventually_atTop.mp (hx.and (hg.eventually (ball_mem_nhds y (by positivity : 0 < ε/4))))
   refine ⟨i, fun j hj k hk=>?_⟩
   obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩:= hi _ hj; obtain ⟨h3,h4⟩:= hi _ hk
   exact (dist_triangle (f j) y (f k)).trans_lt (by rw [dist_comm y]; linarith only [dist_triangle (f j) (g j) y,dist_triangle (f k) (g k) y,h1,h3,mem_ball.mp h2,mem_ball.mp h4])

proof_context.conclusion: A sequence in a complete metric space that is eventually ε-close to a convergent sequence for every ε converges (Cauchy).
